brief:
**BLUF:** Bluefield, WV police are actively seeking Hallie Graham, considered armed and dangerous, on warrants for first-degree attempted murder, three counts of wanton endangerment, and malicious assault after an alleged early Saturday incident at Wild Riders Saloon. No other law enforcement, fire/EMS, hazard, or major government developments were reported in Tazewell County or immediate surrounds in the last 24 hours. NWS alerts remain none active.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/04/woman-wanted-attempted-murder-following-alleged-saturday-saloon-incident/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
- Bluefield, WV Police Department seeks public assistance locating **Hallie Graham**, who has active warrants for Attempted Murder in the First Degree, three counts of wanton endangerment, and malicious assault. The warrants stem from an alleged incident early Saturday morning (Oct. 3) at Wild Riders Saloon in Bluefield, WV (Mercer County). Graham should be considered armed and dangerous; do not approach. Contact Bluefield PD at (304) 327-6101 (option 1) or 911 with information. Patrolman P.S. Mullins is the investigator. [OSINT - NEWS][[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/04/woman-wanted-attempted-murder-following-alleged-saturday-saloon-incident/)

Nothing else reported in the last 24 hours for Tazewell County Sheriff's Office, Virginia State Police, Richlands/Tazewell/Bluefield VA police, or related agencies.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours. No active NWS alerts.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
- Tazewell County School Board will hold a public hearing on the interim appointment to fill the Northwestern District vacancy (term through December 2027) on Monday, Oct. 12, 2026, at 7:15 p.m. at the Tazewell County Career and Technical Center – Student Center, 260 Advantage Drive, Tazewell, VA 24651. Public comments accepted; applicant names announced at the hearing. [OSINT - WEB][[2]](https://wvlegals.com/public-notice-35529/)

## OTHER LOCAL
- Multiple community events occurred Saturday, Oct. 3, including the 10th Annual Oktobrewfest on Main Street in Tazewell (with shuttle service), Pocahontas Pumpkin Festival, and related activities. Main Street was closed to traffic from noon through 11:30 p.m. for the festival. [OSINT - WEB][[3]](https://www.tazewellchamber.com/events/)
